title: Central Authority
description: Definition of Central Authority under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: the Central Consumer Protection Authority established under section 10
content.plain_language: a central government agency responsible for protecting consumer rights
examples: The Central Consumer Protection Authority is the Central Authority responsible for enforcing consumer protection laws in India
The Central Authority investigates complaints about unfair trade practices
non_examples: A state-level consumer forum is not the Central Authority
A private company is not the Central Authority
